blocks.raw: # Upload Store Data in User Event
blocks.text: Upload Store Data in User Event

blocks.raw:
This feature allows marketers to bulk-upload a list of stores within a condition. It is especially useful when you want to create a journey condition that checks whether a user belongs to a specific set of stores.
The feature also helps to:
blocks.text:
This feature allows marketers to bulk-upload a list of stores within a condition. It is especially useful when you want to create a journey condition that checks whether a user belongs to a specific set of stores.
The feature also helps to:

blocks.raw:
* Reduce the hassle of manually adding multiple stores within a condition
* Eliminate any errors that can be caused while doing so manually.
blocks.text: Reduce the hassle of manually adding multiple stores within a conditionEliminate any errors that can be caused while doing so manually.

blocks.raw: While configuring a condition, whenever you select **Current store > Store**,  the application displays a **Choose file** option. To upload a CSV file that includes the list of stores:
blocks.text: While configuring a condition, whenever you select Current store > Store,  the application displays a Choose file option. To upload a CSV file that includes the list of stores:

blocks.raw: 1. Click **Choose file**. You can choose a file from your computer and upload it directly onto the condition
blocks.text: Click Choose file. You can choose a file from your computer and upload it directly onto the condition

blocks.raw:
2. To download a CSV template, click **Sample.csv** to download
   1. Once you have uploaded a file, the system will check the file for the right data and format and it may take up-to 30 to 150 seconds to read\
      ![](https://files.readme.io/bc51ea7-small-10.png)
   2. If the data uploaded does not match the required format, a trigger is sent to the user to inform them that there are invalid entries within the CSV file

3. To download the data after successfully uploading the CSV file, click the download icon. You can download the data in two formats for referencing:
   1. Store id
   2. Store id, code and name\
      ![](https://files.readme.io/031b26b-small-12.png)
